title: GitHub commit import service — fetch and store last 90 days on connect
description: Create a service that fetches commits and releases from a GitHub repo and stores them in the database. Uses ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING for idempotent imports.
acceptanceCriteria: importCommitsForProject(projectId, octokit, owner, repo) function exists
Fetches commits from the last 90 days
Skips commits already in DB (via SHA unique constraint + ON CONFLICT)
Logs each new commit as a github_commit timeline event
Also imports releases (stores in github_releases table)
New releases log a github_release timeline event

steps.details: In githubService.ts, implement importCommitsForProject: 1) Set since = 90 days ago ISO string. 2) Use octokit.repos.listCommits({ owner, repo, since, per_page: 100 }) — handle pagination with octokit.paginate. 3) For each commit: try INSERT into github_commits (project_id, sha, message, author_name, committed_at, url) ON CONFLICT (sha) DO NOTHING. If inserted (rowCount > 0), award 2 points and log timeline event 'github_commit'.

After commits, call octokit.repos.listReleases({ owner, repo }). Filter to releases within last 90 days. For each: INSERT into github_releases ON CONFLICT (tag_name, project_id) DO NOTHING. If new, award +25 points and log 'github_release' timeline event.
Connect a repo with known commits. After import, verify commits appear in github_commits table and timeline. Run import again — verify no duplicate records.

technicalNotes: Use octokit.paginate for repos with many commits (handles multi-page responses automatically)
GitHub API rate limit: 5000 requests/hour for authenticated users — paginating 90 days of commits is fine for typical repos
